Details.JobSummary: About the Position: This position is located at Barsanti Elementary School. Barsanti Elementary School is part of Fort Campbell Schools in the DoDEA Americas Southeast District. Barsanti ES serves military connected students in PK to grade 4.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Department of Defense Education Activity (DoDEA), as one of only two Federally-operated school systems, is responsible for planning, directing, coordinating, and managing prekindergarten through 12th grade educational programs on behalf of the Department of Defense (DoD). DoDEA is globally positioned, operating 160 accredited schools in 8 districts located in 11 foreign countries, 7 states, Guam, and Puerto Rico. DoDEA employs approximately 15,000 employees who serve more than 72,000 children of active duty military and DoD civilian families. DoDEA is committed to ensuring that all school-aged children of military families are provided a world-class education that prepares them for postsecondary education and/or career success and to be leading contributors in their communities as well as in our 21st century globalized society.
MajorDuties: Serve as an interpreter for deaf and/or hearing impaired students.
Interpret teacher's directions and messages in sign language to students.
Provide supervision of and instruction to students on simple subject matter.
Clearly explain concepts being taught and observe students for understanding.
Develop audio-visual tactile aides and set up lab demonstrations.
Supervise student meal and play times.
Distribute and collect testing materials as needed by students.

Details.JobSummary: About the position: This position is Non-appropriated Fund (NAF) and will be assigned to the 28th FSS Marketing Department at Ellsworth AFB. This position is considered regular full time. You are guaranteed 35 hours, however could work up to 40 hours per week. As a regular employee you are eligible to earn leave and other NAF Benefits.
Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: Thank you for considering employment with Air Force Services Non-Appropriated Funds (NAF). Team Ellsworth is comprised of active duty military, DoD civilians, retirees, and their families-working together to support combat ready operations. The 28th Force Support Squadron (28 FSS) manages various facilities and programs that contribute to the quality of life for members of the Ellsworth Community. The Base itself is one of only two B1 Bomber bases around the world, and in 2019 it was announced that Ellsworth AFB was selected as the preferred location for the first operation B-21 Bomber and formal training unit.
MajorDuties: Designs and creates high quality electronic media, commercial print and website designs. Must be able to produce graphic materials in every stage from concept to delivery. Functions as a design. layout and editorial specialist. Produces materials for use by Force Support facilities and external customers to include newsletters, flyer's, posters brochures, table tents, and other forms of print and electronic media. Develops, organizes and manages advertising media by consulting with supervisors and facility managers. Proofs content to ensure accuracy and timeliness of information and images. Stays abreast of industry trends and technologies and integrates them into the print media. Coordinates with facility managers on answering print related questions from customers. Communicates with supervisor on necessary programming changes. Performs other related duties as assigned. If interested in applying for this position you may preview the online application: https://apply.usastaffing.gov/ViewQuestionnaire/12830908

Details.AgencyMarketingStatement: About Fleet and Family Readiness MISSION We provide world class programs that support Fleet, Fighter and Family Readiness and improve quality of life. OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES Straight Talk Value People Encourage Innovation Good Stewardship Mission Integrity FLEET AND FAMILY READINESS Commander, Navy Region Southeast Fleet and Family Readiness is responsible for policy development, resourcing, and oversight of quality of life programs for Navy Sailors and their families. FFR enables a ready Navy force by providing the following programs and support office functions: Morale, Welfare and Recreation (MWR) Child and Youth Programs (CYP) Fleet and Family Support Program Family and Unaccompanied Housing Galley Programs The integration of programs within FFR is designed to optimize individual programs and their joint operations. The organization of these programs by functional specialty enables staff at all levels of the organization to be selected for their expertise in specific functional areas and enables programs to focus solely on the best delivery of services. Our business processes are continuously monitored for operational effectiveness to ensure our customers receive the highest quality of service.
MajorDuties: Sponsorship and Advertising (50%) Positions at this level do not have personal signature authority for the total commercial sponsorship program. Responsible for assisting in the planning, organizing, contracting, administering, and monitoring of the commercial sponsorship program. Develops a diversified commercial sponsorship program. Solicits sponsorship through advertisements, letters, and personal contacts. Develops collateral materials in support of the solicitation. Develops proposal packages and negotiates best terms for MWR. Initiates contracts and ensures they are agreed to/signed by the appropriate person. Drafts sponsorship agreements and coordinates/staff actions with the appropriate agencies, such as legal counsel. Ensures the development and completion of evaluation/follow-up, reports. Develops training and education materials on event marketing and commercial sponsorship for MWR departments. Serves as the Blue Angel Air Show Coordinator Management Assistant (35%) Assist the Marketing Director with the design and implementation of an all-encompassing marketing program for the MWR Department. Specifically: Assist with all editorial staff work for production of MWR publicity and marketing publications. Assist with the solicitation of the MWR Managers for informational input for all publications. Ensures the timely development, layout, writing, editing, proofing, printing and distribution all MWR publications and advertisements Assist with the overseeing, as well as the production of marketing campaigns from inception to completion. This includes the study and determination of the local marketing base and resources to use within the base. Development of a marketing strategy based on Navy and local MWR regulations, leisure need results, in-house generated marketing results, along with managers' needs. Assist with the production of graphic art services to MWR facilities, such as but not limited to, flyers, posters, signs, banners, print media, photography and video promotional vehicles which will be used to promote the department. Assist with the coordination and marketing control for the overall design of an ongoing Indoctrination system that includes on-site briefing to military personnel reporting to the component and tenant commands supported by the NAS Pensacola composite recreation fund. Assist with all aspects of the MWR commercial sponsorship and advertising program for NAS Pensacola. Promotes the wide range of MWR activities for authorized patrons and guests. Recommends promotional ideas, marketing strategies and distribution plans. Serves on committees to ascertain needs, solicit feedback, and introduce ideas. Updates marketing materials at various MWR/CYP locations. Meets with MWR/CYP Program Managers at various locations to access their programs marketing needs. Attends indoctrinations, special events, and may be required to attend meetings in supervisor's absence. Responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining social interactive application sites for MWR/CYP Programs that pushes the MWR mission and markets NAS Pensacola MWR/CYP as a "customer-driven" organization. Special Events (10%) The incumbent is responsible for managing a comprehensive special events. The incumbent will provide oversight of large community special events, live entertainment, and joint community undertakings to maximize use of facilities and resources. Graphic/Interactive Designer (5%) Responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining web sites and other social interactive application sites for MWR/CYP that pushes the MWR mission and markets NAS Pensacola as a "customer-driven" organization. Specifically: -Collaborates with Marketing Director and Managers to ensure that the content is current, accurate, audience friendly and of high quality. -Creates art, graphics, photographs graphics and other multimedia files as necessary for integration on websites and other online/social interactive sites. -Finds and tells the story around a given idea, event or program. Writes copy suited for web browsing yet conveys enough information to interest and inform the customer. -Update, revise, or remove internet content in a timely manner. -Implements the MWR electronic publishing for dissemination of information using email, websites, social net-working sites and new technologies as available. -Manages a response system for web-generated e-mail, phone calls, and regular mail, ensuring that responses are timely and that they reflect well on the Department. -Maintains social net-working email listings to compose and send timely, informative messages to MWR's target audience. -stays current with latest graphic design programs, user interface and web technology trends. -Ensures integrity of communications by keeping informed on legislation and DOD policies that affect internet and web site content. -Other related duties as may be assigned by management.

Details.JobSummary: Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) is looking for the best and brightest to join our Team! MCCS is a comprehensive program that supports and enhances the quality of life for Marines, their families, and others in the Marine Corps Community. We offer a team oriented environment comprised of military personnel, civilian employees, contractors and volunteers who keep the organization functioning smoothly and effectively.
MajorDuties: Maintains Social Media relationships associated with established profiles for Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Instagram. Creates and maintains visible profiles on multiple social media platforms. Proactively engages with users daily via online communities. Develops and implements social networking strategies for all ads and promotions offered. Formulates and manages viral marketing campaigns maintaining presence on social networks including MCCS community sites, Facebook, Instagram, and others. Assists in implementing social networking plans and promotional activities developed by management. Supports digital marketing campaigns and maintains MCCS presence on approved social media networks. Coordinates posting of contact to various platforms in accordance with established plans and guidance. Creates and edits basic graphic elements and short (15-40 seconds) videos with Adobe Creative Cloud software programs that are to be utilized on social media sites and other digital platforms. Suggests improvements to social media practices and strategies and identifies new technologies and business practices for consideration. Provides guidance and assistance to all MCCS social media administrators within various Divisions on the use of social media tools and compliance with established media policies. Writes, proofs, edits, and organizes information for daily social media posts, weekly stories, briefs, speeches, scripts, articles and digital or print publications and campaign assets. Works with marketing staff to ensure all MCCS facilities and events are presented well and information is accurate. Shoots photos and video at various events, programs and facilities to produce marketing materials. Assists in communication and promotional requirements, including developing exhibits, brochures, calendars, and posters. Organizes daily workload to meet established deadlines and assignments. Coordinates with the Graphic Arts Manager and Digital Media Manager to ensure content is posted accurately and on schedule, to reach target audiences. Occasionally works at special events and provides social media and photographic support for MCCS functions. Provides World Class Customer Service with an emphasis on courtesy. Assists customers and communicates positively in a friendly manner. Acknowledges customers, smiles and makes eye contact. Asks questions to determine, verify and solve problems. Checks for satisfaction on the quality of goods and services. Takes action to solve problems quickly. Alerts the higher-level supervisor or proper point of contact for help when problems arise. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Uses required safety equipment, and observes safe work procedures. Promptly reports any observed workplace hazards, and any injury, occupational illness, and/or property damage resulting from workplace mishaps to the immediate supervisor.
